tasks.name: Concept Brief
tasks.objective: Produce the Concept Brief for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: A one-sentence hook and three named creative pillars
Genre, subgenre, dimension (2D/2.5D/3D/hybrid) and target platforms stated
At least three reference works with what to borrow and what to avoid
One testable differentiator that a competitor could not claim unchanged

reviews.note: Three pillars are each testable, and the differentiator is structural rather than marketing: one tile store drives both the board and the walkable region, with the on-table to descend test written out. Scope boundaries rule out combat, multiplayer and cinematics before any department starts building them. Approved.

tasks.name: Art Direction Bible
tasks.objective: Produce the Art Direction Bible for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Palette, lighting mood and material language given as concrete values
Silhouette and shape-language rules a modeller can follow
Do and do-not lists, each traceable to a creative pillar
Platform-aware fidelity tiers (hero, standard, low) defined

reviews.note: Every value in this bible is the value the build actually uses: sky #6f9dc4 to #d3e6f1, ACES at 1.02 exposure, bloom 0.24/0.55/0.9 in linear HDR, probes at 0.55 outdoors and 0.35 in the cabin, shadows 2048 desktop and 1024 region on the reduced tier. The Standard tier is marked defined-but-not-implemented rather than claimed, which is the honest reading of the code. Do and do-not rows all carry a pillar number. Approved.

tasks.name: Creative Sign-off
tasks.objective: Produce the Creative Sign-off for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every pillar checked against a built and playable version with evidence
Deviations either fixed or recorded as an accepted trade-off in the decision log
